Cartes de la liste officielle des Game C:
Cards from the official Game Changers list in the deck: they count toward the bracket (1 to 5) you announce before the game.
• 0: bracket 1 (Exhibition: themed deck, for fun) or 2 (Core: preconstructed deck level).
• 1 to 3: bracket 3 (Upgraded: clearly upgraded precon).
• 4 or more: bracket 4 (Optimized: no limits, powerful deck).
Bracket 5 (cEDH) is pure competitive play, built to win as fast as possible. Only Game Changers are counted here: two-card combos, chained extra turns and mass land destruction also raise the bracket.
